correctness.rationale: In A⋊C_m with fixed-point-free cyclic complement of order m divisible by 3 and abelian A of size a, the double Engel commutator is trivial for all x when y lies in A, and otherwise exactly for commuting x, proportion 1/a. Thus P(Engel)=(a+m-1)/(am). The complement has precisely two nonidentity cube-one elements; their cosets all cube to one; A has no nonzero 3-torsion, giving P(x^3=1)=(2a+1)/(am). For q=p^{k phi(m)}, p coprime to m, scalar C_m exists inside F_q^*, q→infinity; monotonicity of a universal f yields f(2/m)<=1/m. Independently enumerated group products, cubes and nested commutators in F_7⋊C_3, F_13⋊C_3 and F_13⋊C_6; exact cube counts 15,27,27 and Engel ordered-pair counts 189,585,1404. This finite evidence does not prove the limit.
